The support needs the logs of your device to analyze an issue, for example a failed app installation, a failed setup or an error message. This action collects all relevant logs and system information with administrator rights through the local SelfX service and opens a new e-mail to the support with the report attached. Nothing is sent automatically.

SelfX now collects the logs of your device. This can take several minutes. Nothing on your device is changed.
The report contains the name of your device and your user name. When it is ready, a new e-mail with the report attached opens. Describe your issue and send the e-mail to the support.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with Teams
Action.Explanation: You are experiencing an issue with the Teams client (slowness, incorrect status, transfer error, etc.).
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Teams will close and its local cache folders will be cleared. Save any open work before continuing. Teams will reopen if it was running.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with Word
Action.Explanation: You are working in Word, but it has stopped responding and you can no longer do anything.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Word will close and reopen automatically. Unsaved work may be lost.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with Excel
Action.Explanation: You are working in Excel, but it has stopped responding and you can no longer do anything.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Excel will close and reopen automatically. Unsaved work may be lost.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with the Microsoft Store
Action.Explanation: You have issues with the Microsoft Store (opening the Store, installing apps, etc.).
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The Microsoft Store cache will be reset and the Store will open.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with OneDrive (method 1)
Action.Explanation: You are experiencing issues with the OneDrive client (file or folder synchronization, opening files, etc.).
Action.Alerte_MSG:
OneDrive will close and reopen automatically.
If the issue persists, use method 2.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with OneDrive (method 2)
Action.Explanation: You are experiencing issues with the OneDrive client (file or folder synchronization, opening files, etc.) and have already tried method 1.

Action.Name: The "Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook
Action.Explanation: The "New Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The Teams meeting add-in will be enabled again. Outlook will close and reopen automatically. Unsaved work may be lost.
If the issue persists, please contact your support.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: You have connection issues on your device
Action.Explanation: You are trying to open a website, but the connection does not work, the site cannot be reached or you get errors.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The DNS cache of your device will be cleared in the background. Try again after clicking OK.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Your device is running slow
Action.Explanation: Your device is running slow.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Temporary files and the content of the recycle bin will be deleted.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Restart the Intune service
Restart the network adapters
Action.Explanation: You have network issues and want to restart the network adapters. This action runs with administrator rights through the local SelfX service.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
All network adapters will be restarted. Network access will be interrupted for a short time.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Repair a locked OneDrive file
Send the device logs to the support
Clear Google Chrome browsing data (cache)
Action.Explanation: Websites do not load or display correctly in Google Chrome. The browser cache of all Chrome profiles will be cleared.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Google Chrome will close and its cached browsing data will be deleted.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Clear Firefox browsing data (cache)
Action.Explanation: Websites do not load or display correctly in Firefox. The browser cache of all Firefox profiles will be cleared.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Firefox will close and its cached browsing data will be deleted.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: The "Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook
Action.Explanation: The "New Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Outlook will close and then open again automatically. Unsaved work may be lost.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Start the OneDrive client
Action.Explanation: OneDrive is not running.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Your OneDrive client will be started.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Restart the OneDrive client
Action.Explanation: Restarting OneDrive can solve some issues, for example synchronization issues.

Action.Name: Solve OneDrive synchronization issues (step 1)
Action.Explanation:
You have synchronization issues with your files or folders in OneDrive.
This first step restarts OneDrive. OneDrive will close and then open again automatically.
If the issue persists, run the action "Reset the OneDrive client".

Action.Name: OneDrive does not start: error 0x8004def4
Action.Explanation: The error 0x8004def4 is displayed when OneDrive starts.

Action.Name: Your device is slow: OneDrive uses a lot of memory
Action.Explanation: Your device is running slow and OneDrive seems to use a lot of memory.

Action.Name: Red cross on the OneDrive icon
Action.Explanation: A red cross is displayed on the OneDrive icon.

Action.Name: OneDrive closes by itself
Action.Explanation: OneDrive opens and then closes again by itself.

Action.Name: White cross on OneDrive files
Action.Explanation: A white cross is displayed on OneDrive files or folders.

Action.Name: Issues with OneDrive after changing the Windows password
Action.Explanation:
You changed your password recently and now you have issues with OneDrive, for example synchronization issues.
This step restarts the OneDrive client.

Action.Name: You cannot open files in OneDrive
Action.Explanation: Files stored in OneDrive do not open.

Action.Name: Folders synchronize in OneDrive but not in Teams
Reset the OneDrive client
Action.Explanation:
You have issues with OneDrive, for example synchronization issues.
This step resets your OneDrive client. Resetting the OneDrive client does not cause any data loss.

Action.Name: Solve Teams connection issues
Action.Explanation: You cannot connect to Teams.

Action.Name: Solve Teams profile picture synchronization
Action.Explanation: Your profile picture is not displayed in Teams or is not updated.

Action.Name: Folders synchronize in OneDrive but not in Teams
Teams is stuck on "Loading Microsoft Teams"
Action.Explanation: When you open Teams, the window is stuck on "Loading Microsoft Teams".

Action.Name: Solve Teams synchronization issues
Action.Explanation: You have synchronization issues in Teams.

Action.Name: My Teams client does not open
Action.Explanation: You try to open Teams, but the client does not open.

Action.Name: My Teams client freezes during audio calls
Action.Explanation: Teams freezes during an audio call.

Action.Name: The Teams camera is frozen or not visible
Action.Explanation: Your video is frozen or not visible during a meeting or call.

Action.Name: Teams messages cannot be sent
Action.Explanation: Messages in Teams are not sent and Teams shows "Failed to send".

Action.Name: Display issues when joining a Teams meeting
Action.Explanation: Teams does not display correctly when you join a meeting.

Action.Name: My Teams client opens but does not connect
Action.Explanation: Teams opens, but it does not connect.

Action.Name: My Teams status stays offline
Action.Explanation: Your status in Teams stays "Offline" although you are signed in.

Action.Name: The Teams call window is not displayed
Action.Explanation: Notifications of incoming Teams calls are no longer displayed.

Action.Name: I cannot see the content of a message in Teams
Action.Explanation: You see the message notification and preview, but not the content of the message.

Action.Name: Connection issues after changing the password
Action.Explanation: You cannot connect to Teams after changing your password.

Action.Name: Tabs in Teams do not load
Action.Explanation: When you open tabs in Teams, they do not load correctly.

Action.Name: My Teams status is not correct
Action.Explanation: Your status in Teams is not correct or is not updated.

Action.Name: I cannot open a Teams meeting
Action.Explanation: Teams meetings do not open when you click the link to join.

Action.Name: Sound cuts out during Teams meetings
Action.Explanation: The sound cuts out during Teams meetings.

Action.Name: I cannot create a Teams meeting in the Outlook calendar
Action.Explanation: You cannot create a Teams meeting from the Outlook calendar.
